source_summary: Sparse ink landscape with distant misty hills, broad water bands, foreground rocky bank with trees, and a small rocky islet at right. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper tone are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: distant_right_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large misty mountain mass in the upper right, including its sloping ridge, rounded summit, dark scattered texture strokes, pale interior wash, and the thin base shoreline directly beneath it.
must_preserve: soft grey wash forming the broad mountain body
dark dry-brush dots and short strokes along the summit
thin horizontal shoreline strokes at the base

motifs.name: distant_left_hill
motifs.description: Isolate the lower distant hill range in the upper left and center-left, including the curved ridge, faint parallel contour lines, darker notch near the center, and the subtle horizontal shore/water strokes below.
must_preserve: small darker ink cluster near the central saddle
soft atmospheric fading at both ends

motifs.name: upper_mist_water_band
motifs.description: Isolate the broad quiet water or mist band spanning beneath the distant hills, with sparse horizontal ink lines and soft blank-water spacing.
must_preserve: slightly darker ripples near the far bank

motifs.name: left_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground cluster of tall trunks and pine-like foliage on the left, including multiple slender trunks, bare twig tips, layered dark needle clusters, and the foliage masses rising above the rock bank.
must_preserve: pale trunk wash with darker outlines
overlapping tree silhouettes without nearby calligraphy or seals

motifs.name: central_sparse_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the taller central and right foreground trees with slim trunks, angular branches, sparse dark leaf clusters, and small dangling foliage marks.
must_preserve: long pale trunks with wavering ink outlines
branch forks and angular twig linework

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground rock outcrop and earth bank at the bottom, including the tree bases, layered boulders, dark crevices, dry grass textures, and the sloping ground contours.
must_preserve: dark crevice strokes and ink pools
tree roots and bases embedded in rock
tuft-like grass strokes along the edges
sloping contour lines of the bank

motifs.name: right_rocky_islet
motifs.description: Isolate the small rocky islet on the middle-right water, with low angular rocks, dark shadow strokes, and the horizontal waterline bands around it.
must_preserve: dark brush accents at the base
thin horizontal water bands passing behind and beside it

motifs.name: lower_right_water_shore
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right receding shore and water bands, including the low rounded bank form, layered horizontal ripples, and small dark accents, while excluding bottom seals.
must_preserve: small dark ink accents on the bank
misty separation between water and land

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
